lyrics_notice:
Lyrics come from LRCLIB (lrclib.net), a free collection of lyrics submitted by users. Only the title, the artist and the track length are sent.

• Lyrics are added when saving, and only to files that have none. Existing lyrics are never changed, but a tag holding only a player marker such as [COWON S9] counts as empty and is filled.
• To avoid wrong lyrics, they are added only when the artist, the version (instrumental, TV size) and the length (within 3 seconds) all match, and the lyrics submitted for the song agree with each other. Many songs are therefore not found: recent songs and well-known artists usually are, older or lesser-known songs rarely.
• Instrumental, Off Vocal and Karaoke files get no lyrics.
• Only plain lyrics are added, without timestamps.
• The server is often busy. Songs missed for that reason are marked "server busy" and their tags are saved anyway; saving again later looks them up again.
• Looking up lyrics adds a few seconds per song to saving.
• Lyrics are copyrighted. Use them only for your own files and do not share files that contain them.
• A wrong lyric can still slip through. If it does, Undo brings back the file as it was before saving.

cli_desc: Fills title, artist, album and cover art into untagged music files. Files are never uploaded; only the query and an audio fingerprint are sent.
cli_auto: Save without asking when the match is {score} or higher
cli_overwrite: Overwrite existing tags and cover with the candidate (--auto only fills empty fields by default)
cli_lyrics: Add LRCLIB lyrics to files without lyrics (only when artist, version and length match)
cli_sound: Find by sound instead of by text
cli_undo: Restore the original tags from the backup (.tagbak.json)
cli_help: show this help message and exit
cli_auto_skipped: best match {score} is below the bar, skipping
